name: LearnWorlds
description_en:
LearnWorlds is a hosted learning-business platform combining course creation, a branded school website, learner delivery and commerce. It supports course sellers as well as training providers serving client organizations.

A useful plan comparison includes active learners, administrators, enrollment charges, AI credits and add-ons. An unlimited course count does not mean unlimited learners or a bundled branded mobile app.
description_zh:
LearnWorlds 是托管学习业务平台，结合创课、品牌学校网站、学习交付和电商，服务课程销售者及面向客户机构的培训方。

选套餐需同时比较活跃学员、管理员、选课收费、AI credits 和附加产品。课程数不限，不等于学员不限，也不代表包含品牌移动应用。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Paid subscriptions with plan-specific active learners and AI credits; Starter charges $5 per paid enrollment, add-ons and taxes separate.

official_check.scope: Public official documentation research; no account, purchase, live workflow, performance, owner identity or publication approval verified.

review_notes: Original English research and corresponding Chinese translation by Codex AI; vendor documentation is not independent product testing.
Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.en: The official site describes videos, ebooks, assessments, certificates, live sessions, communities and SCORM-based content. Interactive video adds transcripts, quizzes and navigation aids. Website building, payments and marketing support the commercial side. Plan eligibility still matters: SCORM, white-labeling, APIs and client groups should be checked against the chosen plan rather than inferred from the feature menu.
sections.zh: 官网介绍视频、电子书、考核、证书、实时课程、社区及 SCORM 内容。交互视频添加转录、测验和导航辅助。网站、支付及营销支持商业运营。SCORM、白标、API 和客户组仍需按所选套餐检查，不能因功能菜单出现就假定可用。

sections.title_en: Example: launch a paid product-training course
sections.title_zh: 示例：发布收费产品培训课程
sections.en: Create one short course, configure enrollment and a completion check, and connect a supported payment account. Use a test buyer to inspect checkout, learner access and the resulting report. Test cancellation or payment failure so access and records do not rely only on a successful transaction. AI-generated assessments need an expert answer review. This is an illustrative pilot, not a completed payment test.
sections.zh: 创建短课程，配置选课及完成检查，连接受支持的支付账户。用测试买家检查结账、学习访问及报告，也要检查取消或支付失败，不能只看成功交易。AI 生成考核需由专家核对答案。本例是试点建议，本文未实际测试支付。

sections.en: The monthly view lists Starter at 29/month and Pro Trainer at 99/month; the annual view shows 24 and 79 per month billed annually. The plan matrix explicitly shows a $5 fee per paid enrollment on Starter and no platform enrollment fee on higher plans. Starter includes 1,000 monthly active learners, one admin and 300 monthly AI credits. Pro Trainer lists 2,000 learners, five admins and 500 credits. A branded mobile app, extra email and extra AI credits are add-ons. Verify checkout currency and taxes before relying on a total.
sections.zh: 月付视图列 Starter 每月 29、Pro Trainer 每月 99；年付视图分别折算每月 24 和 79。套餐表明确显示 Starter 每次付费选课收五美元，较高套餐不收平台选课费。Starter 含每月 1,000 活跃学员、一名管理员和 300 AI credits，Pro Trainer 含 2,000 学员、五名管理员和 500 credits。品牌移动应用、额外邮件和 AI credits 需加购。总额应以结账币种及税费为准。

sections.title_en: A course business still needs an operating model
sections.title_zh: 课程业务仍需运营设计
sections.en: Begin with a trial and a clear content/payment/learner workflow. The pricing FAQ describes a 30-day trial, not a permanent free school. Decide who handles refunds, course updates, learner support and evidence exports before selling. LearnWorlds is relevant to delivering and selling a branded learning experience; it does not itself validate pedagogy, sales demand or regulatory certification. Self-hosting, source licensing and full restoration behavior remain unverified.
sections.zh: 从试用和明确的内容、支付、学员流程开始。套餐 FAQ 描述 30 天试用，并非永久免费的学校。销售前需明确退款、课程更新、学员支持和证据导出的负责人。它适合交付并销售品牌学习体验，但不会自动验证教学方法、市场需求或监管认证。自托管、源码许可和完整恢复行为仍未核实。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source documentation research, original English synthesis and Chinese translation; examples are hypothetical and unexecuted.

research_gaps.en: Verify checkout currency, payment processing, tax, selected-plan SCORM/API rights and refund/access behavior.
research_gaps.zh: 需核对结账币种、支付处理、税费、所选套餐 SCORM/API 权益及退款访问行为。

research_gaps.en: No live account, purchase, recovery or performance test was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际创建账户、购买、测试恢复或测量性能。
